entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 掘地蟲是形似巨型昆蟲的掘穴怪獸，潛伏在田野與森林的鬆軟土壤之下，感應到地面的震動便破土而出攫取獵物。牠能噴吐腐蝕性的酸液，留下的隧道雖然讓土地變得肥沃，卻也讓農人與牲畜提心吊膽。

Oversize insects, ankhegs burrow close to the surface, creating sprawling underground labyrinths. From these tunnels, they burst forth to dissolve and devour smaller creatures using their acid-dripping mandibles and sprays of digestive enzymes.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 猬魔全身長滿尖刺，是九層地獄中警覺性極高的守衛，負責看守寶庫與要地。牠們貪婪成性，樂於用尖刺與拋擲的火焰對付任何闖入者。

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 鬚魔是九層地獄的突擊步兵，下巴長著蠕動的蛇狀鬚，被刺中會中毒。牠們手持鋸齒長刀並肩作戰，那種刀留下的傷口會血流不止。
Bearded devils' eponymous beards consist of tentacle-like growths that prevent magical healing.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 平民是世上最常見的普通人：農夫、工匠、僕役、商販與乞丐等等。他們沒有受過戰鬥訓練，面對怪物時幾乎毫無自保之力。

Commoners constitute the majority of people who don't pursue magical talents, extraordinary training, or a life of adventure. Some are generous, helpful sorts, while others are more cautious in sharing what they have.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 這些老鼠被一名心懷惡意的前冒險者以魔法腐化，身上長滿斑塊而病懨懨的，有些還長到狗一般大。

Corrupted by a malevolent ex-adventurer's magic, the rats of Elmshire are mottled and sickly. Their organs glow and bubble beneath their scabby hides as if ready to pop. These pests sometimes gather in squeaking tides, devouring everything in their path.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 狄摩高根邪教徒崇拜惡魔親王狄摩高根，以極端的手段散播瘋狂的信仰。

Cultists use extreme measures to spread radical beliefs. They often follow obscure mystical traditions or obsess over interpretations of ancient prophecies. They might worship supernatural patrons—deities, otherworldly creatures, manipulative alien minds, or stranger forces.

Some cultists devote themselves to Demogorgon, the self-proclaimed Prince of Demons. These cultists garb themselves in costumes that resemble the two-headed beast they worship. Their two-faced, monstrous masks and tentacled sleeves strike fear into those they aim to subjugate. Like the demon lord they worship, cultists of Demogorgon revel in chaos, domination, and destruction.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 「被放逐者」達杜是一名充滿魅力的魔鬼表演家，野心如火，深知如何抓住觀眾的心。
Dardew the Banished is a devilishly charming showman with fiery ambition. He knows how to delight an audience, even if it means making a few infernal pacts on the sly for a truly juicy spectacle.

Dardew is a cambion, a former mortal corrupted by an otherworldly power. His red skin and leathery wings betray his fiendish nature, and his boisterous but smooth voice commands attention. When that fails him, he accentuates his words with audacious riffs on his wicked lute.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 魔蝠是惡魔國度特有的黏滑有翼害獸，嘴裡長著四排鋸齒狀的牙。

Demobats are slimy, winged pests endemic to demonic realms. A demobat has four serrated tentacles, which trail behind it during flight, and its eyeless head opens wide to reveal a toothed maw. Demobats hunt in flocks, using their tails to strangle and immobilize their prey as they feed.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 魔犬是從蛞蝓般的幼體長成的四足惡魔掠食者，頭部像花瓣一樣張開，露出層層利齒。

Demodogs are sinister, quadrupedal predators that spawn from limacine larvae. From a distance, they loosely resemble hairless dogs with tough, wrinkled hides and faceless, flower-like heads. When a demodog attacks, its head parts to reveal powerful jaws framed by toothed, fleshy petals.
Like wolves, demodogs typically hunt in packs, overwhelming their prey in gloomy places. Their howls strike fear into the most hardened adventurers.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 魔龍曾是惡魔親王狄摩高根的愛寵，一頭雙頭的龍形惡魔。
Once the prized pet of Demogorgon, Prince of Demons, the demodragon now resides in the Nine Hells, where it serves as the gatekeeper of the Hellfire Games' final challenge.

Raised by vile magic from the corpse of a beheaded black dragon, the demodragon is the picture of its creator: an abomination with three writhing tails, monstrous wings, and two hideous heads. Initially, each bulbous head appears featureless—a disturbing, preternatural bud yet to bloom. When threatened, however, each unfurls to reveal a flower-like arrangement of glistening flesh and teeth around two crushing jaws.

Though the head of the dragon from which the demodragon spawned is long gone, its breath remains. Without warning, the demodragon can unleash a deluge of bone-melting acid on any who dare challenge it.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 狄摩高根衍體是惡魔領主狄摩高根的怪物後代，瘦長的雙足生物，頭部能像花瓣般裂開。

Monstrous offspring of the bestial demon lord Demogorgon, these spawn are lean, bipedal creatures with bulbous, featureless heads. A Demogorgon spawn's head opens like a flower in bloom, revealing a gaping maw and five or more fleshy petals lined with teeth.
Light flickers in the presence of these resilient predators, foretelling their arrival. Demogorgon spawns relentlessly pursue their prey.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 怯魔是最低等的惡魔之一，矮胖醜陋、愚笨又怨天尤人，在深淵中成群遊蕩，被更強的惡魔驅趕著充當砲灰。牠們能釋放一股令人作嘔的惡臭氣體。

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 弗利佐賓是一名愛玩遊戲的地侏騙子，專門引誘新手冒險者進入地城。

A trickster with a penchant for games, Flizzlebin tempts novice adventurers into dungeons to test their skills. The so-called "Vanishing Gnome's" favorite game involves hiding within dangerous dungeons and rewarding those who find him with priceless treasures.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 這些老鼠被一名心懷惡意的前冒險者以魔法腐化，身上長滿斑塊而病懨懨的，有些還長到狗一般大。

The rats of Elmshire sometimes grow to unusual proportions. Though frightening, these dog-size rodents were little more than a local nuisance until an ex-adventurer's magic transformed them into feral terrors. Caustic drool drips from their chattering incisors, and glowing pustules pockmark their bloated, ghastly hides.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 巨蜘蛛是體型如馬的捕食性蜘蛛，在洞穴、森林與廢墟中結下堅韌的黏網，以毒牙麻痺落網的獵物，再裹成繭慢慢吸食。
Some spiders are big—others are really big.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 豺狼人戰士渴求無止境的殺戮，卻很快就對到手的獵物失去興趣，轉而尋找下一個目標。

Gnoll warriors crave endless slaughter but quickly grow bored with the prey they kill and the treasures they plunder. Nevertheless, they're enraged by the thought of anyone else having what's theirs, compelling them to ruin what they can't take with them.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 哥布林是魯莽與破壞的化身，以搗毀東西為樂，聲響越大越開心。

Goblins are embodiments of recklessness and ruin. They delight in wreckage—the louder, the more energetic, and the more convoluted, the better. Goblin raids are often as much opportunities to enjoy setting fires and tormenting livestock as they are parts of more disruptive plots.
Goblin warriors excel at causing mischief, but some devote themselves to nobler pursuits.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 衛兵是受雇於城鎮、貴族或商人的守衛，包括城市守望、哨兵與保鑣。他們受過基本訓練，負責巡邏與維持秩序。

Guards protect people, places, and things, either for pay or from a sense of duty. They might perform their duties vigilantly or distractedly. Some raise alarms at the first sign of danger and defend their charges with their lives. Others flee outright if their compensation doesn't match the danger they face. Guards are perceptive, but most have little martial training. They might be bouncers, lookouts, members of a city watch, or other keen-eyed warriors.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 地獄獵犬是來自下層位面、能噴吐火焰的兇惡犬形邪魔，成群獵殺並吞食獵物。火巨人等邪惡生物常把牠們馴養成看門犬與獵犬。

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 梅杜莎是為了換取永恆的美貌與青春而與黑暗力量交易的凡人，最終卻受到詛咒，頭髮化為群蛇，凡是與她四目相交的生物都會變成石像。她們獨居在荒廢的宅邸中，四周立滿栩栩如生的石像；鏡子是她們的剋星，因為自己的凝視同樣會將她們石化。

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 枯萎怪是從根深蒂固的邪惡中萌生的惡毒植物，扭曲的形體模仿著類人的樣子。枯針怪會射出尖針，枯藤怪則用藤蔓纏住獵物。

Blights are malicious plants that sprout from deep-rooted evil. Their gnarled forms twist with fearsome features suggestive of human limbs and vicious maws. Blights lurk in ambush amid mundane vegetation and lash out at non-Plant creatures.

Needle blights have vaguely bipedal forms, with gaunt, misshapen limbs. Whether standing unnaturally still or lurching with their awkward gaits, these blights can't pass as either normal plants or woodland travelers. Once they spot foes, needle blights attack using their thorn-covered claws or by rapidly growing and flinging volleys of serrated, needlelike projectiles.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 莉莉·茱恩是一名勤奮的半身人農夫，習慣自己動手解決難題。

Rilly June is a hardworking halfling farmer who's used to tackling tough jobs herself. When her grandfather's farm started to suffer from a mysterious blight, she was determined to investigate the cause. Rilly June is stern and tough, but she's got a soft spot for animals and the other people who work her family's land or look out for the common folk.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 稻草人是被鬼婆或邪惡施法者以死去邪惡生物的靈魂活化的構裝體。它平時紋風不動地立在田野中，那恐怖的凝視能把人嚇得動彈不得，再用利爪撕碎對方。

Spirits of vengeance bound to crude frames, scarecrows arise from folk magic, the prayers of desperate commoners, or possession by spirits that died with violent work left undone. Scarecrows might serve those who created them or might defend a place, family, or community from threats—whether physical or to their way of life.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 陰影是形如活動黑影的不死生物，會吸取生者的力量；被它吸乾而死的人，自己的影子也會化為新的陰影。它畏懼陽光，卻被生者的活力吸引，心地越純善的人越容易成為目標。

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 尖叫蕈一受到光照或驚擾，就會發出尖銳刺耳的聲音，把附近的掠食者引過來。
If exposed to light or otherwise disturbed, mushroom-like shriekers emit a high-pitched noise that gives them their name. This wailing might alert other creatures or attract predators.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 枯萎怪是從根深蒂固的邪惡中萌生的惡毒植物，扭曲的形體模仿著類人的樣子。枯針怪會射出尖針，枯藤怪則用藤蔓纏住獵物。

Blights are malicious plants that sprout from deep-rooted evil. Their gnarled forms twist with fearsome features suggestive of human limbs and vicious maws. Blights lurk in ambush amid mundane vegetation and lash out at non-Plant creatures.

Vine blights resemble humans wrapped in vines common to the areas in which they grow, from hairy ivy vines to flowering kudzu. They can cause plants to burst from the ground around themselves and entangle nearby foes.

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 紫蕈行動緩慢，卻會伸出觸鬚抽打靠近的生物，使碰到的血肉腐爛。
Slow but mobile, violet fungi rot any flesh they touch with their lashing tendrils.
